IND.reason: IBM reports domestic manganese ore consumption and imports for ferroalloys. Fiscal-year national series is not calendar-year exports. Research context only.

CHN.reason: Eramet annual market discussion describes Chinese steel demand and ore port inventories. No export/mine identity; research context only.

GAB.reason: Comilog is an operation, not automatically all Gabon; internal/external sales, stocks and other producers need reconciliation. A ratio cannot establish a single-origin industry.

AUS.reason: Multiple operations, equity versus 100 percent, wet tonnes, financial year and cyclone interruptions require review.

ZAF.reason: Multiple producers and domestic alloys preclude an assumed single-mine export anchor.

NLD.reason: Potential transit/reexport role must be established for manganese specifically; geography or a high export/production ratio is not evidence.
